messages.author: 5a7d96b840c23bef
messages.subject: Stan at ACoP7
parts:
Hi All,

Stan got some exposure this week at the American Conference on Pharmacometrics (ACoP7, http://www.acop7.org/). I presented a one day workshop on Sunday entitled "Getting Started with Bayesian PKPD Modeling Using Stan: Practical use of Stan and R for PKPD applications" (http://metrumrg.com/events/2016/10/23/bayesianpkpd.html). I also presented a talk on Monday entitled "Bayesian pharmacometric modeling with BUGS, NONMEM and Stan" (slides attached). Charles Margossian and I also presented a poster on Tuesday called "Stan Functions for Bayesian Pharmacometric Modeling" (poster attached) describing some of the work we have done in collaboration with the Stan development team. 

Cheers,
Bill

Hi Bill,

Awesome! I'm glad you're out there getting the word out on Stan!

Perhaps we can discuss the wishlist you have as a separate thread on stan-users. I'll need a little more info to triage them into things that just need implementation, things that need more research to accomplish, and things that have no realistic chance at being included.


Daniel
